title: PolyTermInstRow
html:
定义组：System F 双绑定替换与规约。有序参数：z2049、z2050、z2051。

项 β 的绑定删除：经过 h 个类型绑定时，插入项先作类型提升 h，再作项提升 c。：单行局部条件。

规范公式

                (@ Pair c z2054 z2051)))

                          (or
                            (exists z2064

                            (exists z2066
                            (exists z2067
                            (and
                            (@ TApp z2064 z2065 t)

                            (exists z2080

                            (or

                            (exists z2064
                            (exists z2066
                            (exists z2061
                            (and
                            (@ FTInst z2064 z2061 t)
                            (and
                            (@ FTInst z2066 z2061 u)
                            (exists z2090

                            (@ App z2049 z2090 z2091)
